title: Industries
description: AI automations for real estate teams, clinics and dental practices, agencies and B2B sales teams, and bookkeeping firms. See what we set up for each.

hero.title: Built around how your kind of business runs
hero.lede: We focus on four kinds of small business, where the slow, repetitive work is easy to name and worth automating. Pick yours to see what we set up, what a person still does, and what it should be worth.

other.title: Not on this list?
other.text: If your business runs on enquiries, appointments, documents or follow-ups, the same building blocks apply. Bring one slow process to a free audit. You leave with a costed plan for automating it, whether or not you hire us.
